data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme replicating/tracking domestic price of Gold
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide investment returns closely corresponding to the Domestic Price of Gold before expenses, subject to tracking errors, fees and expenses by investing in physical gold. However, there is no assurance that the objective of the Scheme will be realized, and the Scheme does not assure or guarantee any returns.
